name: Mermaid Direct (bypass mcp_call double-escape)
description: Long-lived child-process JSON-RPC client for mermaid-tui-mcp that bypasses the gsd-pi mcp_call transport's \n double-escape. Ships 7 tools (mermaid_render/pin/unpin/get/list/search/delete) that talk to the mermaid server over raw stdio so multi-line Mermaid source survives.
